messages:
maria: heads-up — small-pods stuck pending in us-west2c since ~09:12. 100+ tiny pods in Pending with PodAffinity/anti-affinity + node taints. Looks like binpacking left lots of single-gpu nodes with 1-2 free tiny slots.

sre-bot: Alert: PendingPods > 80 in namespace=training (us-west2c) triggered at 2025-04-12T09:12:34Z

sam: can you paste a `kubectl describe` for one pending pod? suspect scheduler is respecting `requiredDuringScheduling` affinity too strictly.

maria: snippet:
```
Events:
  Type     Reason             Age                From               Message
  ----     ------             ----               ----               -------
  Warning  FailedScheduling   2m (x15 over 5m)   default-scheduler   0/50 nodes are available: 10 node(s) had taints that the pod didn't tolerate, 30 node(s) had insufficient gpu, 10 node(s) matched nodeSelector.
```
Node labels: `node.k8s.redwood/slot-size=tiny` vs our pool label `gpu.size=small` mismatch.

oliver: ugh—label drift between provisioning scripts and nodepool autoscaler. This explains fragmentation: we have lots of `tiny` slots scattered, then big pods ask for `small` and can't pack. Costwise tiny nodes are underutilized but still billed.

lee: short-term: we can add a scheduler-extender patch to relax the topologySpread/affinity for namespace=training, or taint those tiny nodes with `dedicated=tiny` and evict low-priority pods to consolidate.

sam: evicting will cause rollbacks for some training jobs. maybe use `kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` on target tiny nodes and let cluster autoscaler reschedule onto small nodes. Need approval from ML infra.

maria: ML infra ok with controlled drain for 12 nodes (canary 2 then 10). I'll run a preflight: list nodes with label mismatch and free slot < 4.

sre-bot: Deploy pipeline: runbook for node-drain initiated by maria. Link: https://confluence.internal/redwood/drains

oliver: long-term: reconcile provisioning templates + run a compaction job that migrates low-priority pods to shared small pools and retire fragmented tiny nodes. Also add a nightly compaction job and metric `slot_fragmentation_ratio`.

lee: +1. Also consider lowering packing threshold in scheduler plugin from 0.9 -> 0.8 for tiny pods to force coalescing.

maria: action items: (1) canary drain 2 nodes at 09:40 UTC (2) run compaction script draft (PR #4221) (3) change scheduler threshold trial next week. I'll post updates.

sam: thanks. please ping #oncall if evictions spike.

maria: will do. :thumbsup:
